why: Definition item: only EpNatTrans (a structure) and EpFunctor.NaturallyEquivalent (Nonempty (EpNatTrans F G)) are listed, so A = True and both implications are vacuous; the content is B itself, proved outright as B_holds. The fields of EpNatTrans (app sc-smooth X → 𝐘, s(app x) = F x, t(app x) = G x, naturality for every h with x = s h, x' = t h) are exactly B's IsNatTransB; B's naturality over h, x, x' with s h = x, t h = x' is the project's naturality h after substitution, and conversely the structure built from B's conditions has app = τ. Hence NaturallyEquivalent F G ↔ ∃ τ, IsNatTransB F G τ. Universes: B is in Type, the project notions at u = v = 0.
overlap: 0 shared project theorems (B_to_A is trivial); B_holds uses only the fields of EpNatTrans.
